results.title: Inferno
results.overview: Based on true events, the film follows Mathilde Cordier, a young detective from the Criminal Investigation Division with a history of abuse, is laid off as an intervention goes awry. Following the disappearance of a young girl, Mathilde, outside the law, will conduct her own investigation and follow the trail of a man named François Renard. A man with a troubled and violent past who claims to have settled down. As she sinks into a spiral of darkness, Mathilde faces the most monstrous aspects of humanity.

results.title: At Midnight Vol. 2
results.overview: A chilling return to the shadows, At Midnight: Volume 2 delves deeper into the haunted heart of northern Mexico. This new anthology brings to life six terrifying legends from the Comarca Lagunera—where real stories and supernatural whispers collide. Encounter vengeful spirits, cursed rituals, and nightmarish apparitions in tales such as The Boy Who Flew Over Torreón, The Witches of Mercado Juárez, Jesús Solís: The Blind Collector, The Goblin of Venustiano Carranza Forest, La Cubana, and The Tzitzimimeh. Each chapter uncovers a new layer of Mexico’s ancestral fear, resurrecting local folklore. Dare to wander the desert after dark?

results.title: Harry Chapin - Cat’s in the Cradle: The Song That Changed Our Lives
results.original_title: Harry Chapin - Cat’s in the Cradle: The Song That Changed Our Lives
results.overview: The documentary "Cat's In the Cradle: The Song that Changed Our Lives " explores the legacy of Harry Chapin's iconic song, 50 years after its release. With insights from Billy Joel, Pat Benatar, Dee Snider, Judy Collins, and more, the film reflects on the song's enduring impact and universal themes of fatherhood, time, and the relationships that shape our lives.

results.title: Greater Kalesh
results.overview: Twinkle returns home for a surprise Diwali trip, but secrets and disagreements test her family's bonds in ways she never imagined.

results.title: Only Your Name in My Prayers
results.overview: Nala live a seemingly harmonious family. The father always prayed for his family to remain healthy and happy, both in this world and the hereafter. However, a figure from the father's past, whose matters remained unresolved, eventually caused a rift in their family life.

results.title: Odela 2
results.overview: A savior, Odela Mallanna Swamy, protects a village from evil forces.

results.title: Un Padre Muy Madre
results.overview: Dennis Rodríguez, manager and sole employee of a family business he must save from foreclosure, receives the news that his girlfriend is pregnant, but she doesn't want a child. Dennis decides to take on this challenge: he will be both a father and a mother to that baby, which leads him to embark on a new path full of surprises that will radically change him.

results.title: Miss O'Dell

results.title: Iliza Shlesinger: A Different Animal
results.overview: Acclaimed comedian Iliza Shlesinger debuts on Amazon Prime with a no-holds-barred, explosive and relentlessly funny hour special where she covers everything from shower sex, ugly wives and the ideal man to the truth about the ONE thing no woman wants… in this special, nothing is off limits.

results.title: Mutual Pain
results.overview: Mutual Pain is a nonlinear, experimental psychodrama film about love's pain, social violence, and the effect of anxiety on perception. ​​​​​​

results.title: Yuyaymanta
results.overview: During the Indigenous uprising of June 2022 in Ecuador, thousands of people rose up against neoliberal policies and state repression. Yuyaymanta gathers testimonies from survivors and relatives of the victims, intertwining archives and memory to document physical wounds, emotional scars, and the dignity of resistance. Through these voices, the documentary builds a tribute to those who fought, those who fell, and those who continue to seek justice.

results.title: Ayyana Mane
results.overview: Ayyana Mane is a 2025 Kannada-language crime thriller series directed by Ramesh Indira and produced by Shruthi Naidu Productions. It stars Kushee Ravi, Akshya Nayak, Manasi Sudhir, Vijay Shobraj, and Ramesh Indira himself.

results.title: Disectoid
results.overview: What seems like an average day on the course is anything but that! When a young caddie named Ron (Jay Maudlin) is fired by his Boss (Lucas Rendón), he must do what he thinks is right as a response to the predicament. Shot, filmed, and edited in 10 days, Disectoid is akin to late night Adult Swim programming and unlike anything you've ever seen.

results.title: Couraça
results.overview: After the massacre of Lampião's band, two cangaceiro lovers journey across Brazil's backlands to return a pregnant female outlaw to her family's home, while confronting desires and choices that no longer have a place in the world around them.

results.title: SEGAL
results.overview: From a shy kid on Long Island to Hollywood Leading Man, during its most prolific decades, legendary entertainer George Segal shares his life story.
